headline: Funding flows. Satellites launch. Space is crowded.
deck: This week saw significant funding rounds and strategic partnerships shaping the space landscape.

stories.head: True Anomaly raises $190M for co-orbital security
stories.body: True Anomaly secured $190M in a Series C funding round, bringing its valuation to $1.6B. The funds will bolster its efforts in co-orbital security and space domain awareness, with a clear nod toward DoD partnerships. It seems that the Department of Defense is keen on keeping its satellites safe from the increasingly crowded skies.
stories.soWhat: With the DoD's backing, True Anomaly is positioned to play a crucial role in the future of space security, potentially outpacing competitors who lack such direct ties.

stories.head: Anduril and L3Harris team up for SDA constellation
stories.body: Anduril and L3Harris are joining forces to bid on a tactical Space Development Agency (SDA) constellation, a move that highlights the growing trend of collaboration in the defense sector. This partnership could leverage L3Harris's satellite experience and Anduril's tech-savvy approach, making for a formidable combination. With defense budgets swelling, this bid is likely to attract significant attention.
stories.soWhat: This collaboration signals a shift toward more integrated approaches in defense tech, where partnerships may become as critical as the technologies themselves.

stories.head: FY27 budget boosts space resilience funding by $1.4B
stories.body: The FY27 budget markup has allocated an additional $1.4B for space resilience, reflecting a heightened focus on safeguarding U.S. space assets. This increase is part of a broader strategy to enhance capabilities amid rising geopolitical tensions. As space becomes more contested, this funding could be a game-changer for national security priorities.
stories.soWhat: Expect a flurry of proposals and initiatives as companies scramble to align with this newfound funding focus, potentially reshaping the competitive landscape.

watchlist.title: Keep an eye on LatConnect 60's funding
watchlist.body: With an accelerated growth investment round announced, LatConnect 60's push for a high-resolution satellite constellation could redefine AUKUS-related capabilities.

watchlist.title: Watch for SpaceX's Starship updates
watchlist.body: As SpaceX emphasizes Starship's role in its growth, any delays or successes will be critical indicators of its future trajectory.

watchlist.title: Anticipate more defense-tech IPOs
watchlist.body: With the defense-tech IPO window cracking open, expect a surge of startups looking to capitalize on this trend in the coming weeks.

watchlist.title: Monitor Sierra Space's Dream Chaser developments
watchlist.body: Having cleared critical design reviews, any news on the Dream Chaser's launch timeline will be pivotal for its market positioning.

talent.statLabel: Week-over-week growth in resumes from primes to Series B/C
talent.head: Talent is leaving big-aero — and it's not about money
talent.body: Compensation is not the gating factor. The complaint, almost universally, is schedule risk — the inability to ship anything quickly, the half-decade gap between joining and seeing flight hardware, the meeting that exists to schedule the meeting. The startups absorbing this talent will, in two years, be hard to compete with on a level playing field.
